#!/bin/sh
[ "$#" -ge 1 ] || exit 0
printf '%s' "$1" | curl -s -m 1 -o /dev/null --unix-socket /root/.wsp/open.sock -X POST --data-binary @- http://wsp/open >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0
set -e
export HOME=/root USER=root
mkdir -p /root/wsp-daemon /root/.wsp/inbox
rm -rf /root/wsp-daemon/.unpacking
mkdir -p /root/wsp-daemon/.unpacking
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /root/wsp-daemon.tgz -C /root/wsp-daemon/.unpacking
(cd /root/wsp-daemon/.unpacking && find . -mindepth 1 -type d) | while IFS= read -r d; do mkdir -p /root/wsp-daemon/"$d"; done
(cd /root/wsp-daemon/.unpacking && find . ! -type d) | while IFS= read -r f; do mv -f /root/wsp-daemon/.unpacking/"$f" /root/wsp-daemon/"$f"; done
rm -rf /root/wsp-daemon/.unpacking
install -m 0755 /root/wsp-daemon/wsp-open /usr/local/bin/wsp-open
ln -sfn /usr/local/bin/wsp-open /usr/local/bin/xdg-open
mkdir -p /etc/profile.d && printf 'export BROWSER=%s\nunset DISPLAY\n' /usr/local/bin/wsp-open > /etc/profile.d/wsp-open.sh
printf 'export __VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS=%s\n' '.preview.example.com' > /etc/profile.d/wsp-preview.sh
export __VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS='.preview.example.com'
WSP_DAEMON_TOKEN='aabbcc'
umask 077
printf '%s' "$WSP_DAEMON_TOKEN" > /root/.wsp/daemon-token.next
mv -f /root/.wsp/daemon-token.next /root/.wsp/daemon-token
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64)
rm -rf /root/wsp-daemon/wsp/assets/daemon/aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
cat > /usr/local/bin/wsp <<'WSP_SHIM'
#!/bin/sh
exec /root/wsp-daemon/wsp/assets/daemon/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/wsp-daemon wsp "$@"
WSP_SHIM
chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/wsp
if command -v apparmor_parser >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -w /etc/apparmor.d ] && [ "$(cat /sys/module/apparmor/parameters/enabled 2>/dev/null)" = Y ]; then
  printf %s 'YWJpIDxhYmkvNC4wPiwKaW5jbHVkZSA8dHVuYWJsZXMvZ2xvYmFsPgpwcm9maWxlIHdzcC13b3Jrc3BhY2UgL3Jvb3Qvd3NwLWRhZW1vbi93c3AvYXNzZXRzL2RhZW1vbi94ODZfNjQtdW5rbm93bi1saW51eC1tdXNsL3dzcC1kYWVtb24gZmxhZ3M9KGRlZmF1bHRfYWxsb3cpIHsKICB1c2VybnMsCiAgaW5jbHVkZSBpZiBleGlzdHMgPGxvY2FsL3dzcC13b3Jrc3BhY2U+Cn0K' | base64 -d > /etc/apparmor.d/wsp-workspace
  if apparmor_parser -r -W /etc/apparmor.d/wsp-workspace 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "the wsp-workspace apparmor profile is loaded, so workspaces isolate here"
  else
    rm -f /etc/apparmor.d/wsp-workspace
    echo "this computer's apparmor does not take the wsp-workspace profile; workspaces here run without it"
  fi
fi
systemctl stop wsp-daemon.service 2>/dev/null || true
old="$(ss -ltnpH 'sport = :7070' | sed -n 's/.*pid=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)"
if [ -n "$old" ]; then
  kill "$old" 2>/dev/null || true
  for _ in $(seq 20); do
    ss -ltnH 'sport = :7070' | grep -q . || break
    sleep 0.25
  done
  ss -ltnH 'sport = :7070' | grep -q . && kill -9 "$old" 2>/dev/null && sleep 0.5
  echo "DAEMON_STOPPED $old"
fi
cat > /etc/systemd/system/wsp-daemon.service <<'WSP_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=wsp daemon
After=network.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/wsp-daemon
Environment=PATH=/root/.local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/sbin:/root/go/bin:/root/.cargo/bin:/root/.local/share/pnpm:/root/.bun/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
Environment=HOME=/root
Environment=USER=root
Environment=__VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS=.preview.example.com
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/wsp/daemon.env
ExecStart=/root/wsp-daemon/wsp/assets/daemon/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/wsp-daemon --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7070 --token-path /root/.wsp/daemon-token --root /root --roots-path /root/.wsp/roots --kind cloud --inbox /root/.wsp/inbox --manifest /root/.wsp/manifest.json --open-socket /root/.wsp/open.sock
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
MemoryMax=80%
OOMPolicy=continue
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
WSP_UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable wsp-daemon.service
systemctl restart wsp-daemon.service
  ;;
  aarch64)
rm -rf /root/wsp-daemon/wsp/assets/daemon/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
cat > /usr/local/bin/wsp <<'WSP_SHIM'

  if apparmor_parser -r -W /etc/apparmor.d/wsp-workspace 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "the wsp-workspace apparmor profile is loaded, so workspaces isolate here"
  else
    rm -f /etc/apparmor.d/wsp-workspace
    echo "this computer's apparmor does not take the wsp-workspace profile; workspaces here run without it"
  fi
fi
systemctl stop wsp-daemon.service 2>/dev/null || true
old="$(ss -ltnpH 'sport = :7070' | sed -n 's/.*pid=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)"

fi
